Name: Wrap A Package
Author: VirtexDawn
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Hate dropping items? Yeah, wrap it.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]You wrap your currently held item as a giftbox.[/color]

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][b]Randomize [Bool]: [/b]When enabled, randomize giftbox's appearance based on Giftbox Variant Option.[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][b]Giftbox Variant [Int] [0-4]:[/b] When randomize is enabled, this act as a limiter. when randomize is disabled, this act as your selected giftbox.[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][b]Allow Tool [Bool] [Unsaved Option]:[/b] Allow you to wrap Tools.[/size][/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (Optional)[/i][/color][/*]
[/list]
